SELECT (SELECT 7 GROUP BY 7+0) AS v, EXISTS(SELECT 7 GROUP BY 7+0) AS hit, 7 IN (SELECT 7 GROUP BY 7+0) AS member
SELECT (SELECT 7 WHERE 0 GROUP BY 7+0) AS v, EXISTS(SELECT 7 WHERE 0 GROUP BY 7+0) AS hit, 7 IN (SELECT 7 WHERE 0 GROUP BY 7+0) AS member
SELECT (SELECT NULL GROUP BY 1) AS v, EXISTS(SELECT NULL GROUP BY 1) AS hit, 7 IN (SELECT NULL GROUP BY 1) AS member
SELECT (SELECT 7 GROUP BY 1 HAVING 0) AS v, EXISTS(SELECT 7 GROUP BY 1 HAVING NULL) AS hit, 7 IN (SELECT 7 GROUP BY 1 HAVING 7=7) AS member
SELECT (SELECT ?1 GROUP BY 1 HAVING ?1 IS NOT NULL) AS v, EXISTS(SELECT ?1 GROUP BY 1 HAVING ?1 IS NOT NULL) AS hit, 7 IN (SELECT ?1 GROUP BY 1) AS member
SELECT (SELECT 7 GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 0) AS v, EXISTS(SELECT 7 GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) AS hit, 7 IN (SELECT 7 GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) AS member
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT json('bad') GROUP BY 1+0) AS hit
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT json('bad') GROUP BY 1+0 ORDER BY json('bad')) AS hit
SELECT (SELECT json('bad') GROUP BY 1+0 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) AS v
SELECT (SELECT json('bad') GROUP BY 1+0 LIMIT 0) AS v
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 7 GROUP BY 1+0 HAVING json('bad')) AS hit
SELECT (SELECT 7 GROUP BY 1) AS ordinal, (SELECT 7 GROUP BY 1+0) AS arithmetic
SELECT x,(SELECT x GROUP BY 1) AS v, EXISTS(SELECT x GROUP BY 1 HAVING x=2) AS hit, x IN (SELECT x GROUP BY 1) AS member FROM t
SELECT (SELECT (SELECT 7 GROUP BY 1) GROUP BY 1+0) AS v
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT missing GROUP BY 1+0) AS invalid
